entities.name: UniProt Q9BIB4
observations: Exact 139-aa sequence match to reviewed Caenorhabditis elegans transcription initiation factor IIA small chain homolog (TFIIA gamma).
Annotated as nuclear and a component of the TFIIA complex; has RNA polymerase II general transcription initiation factor activity and TBP-class protein binding.
Associated biological process: assembly of the RNA polymerase II preinitiation complex.
Pfam matches: TFIIA_gamma_N (PF02268) residues 3–48 and TFIIA_gamma_C (PF02751) residues 59–104.

entities.name: RNA Pol II preinitiation
observations: The exact-match reference carries GO annotation GO:0051123, RNA polymerase II preinitiation complex assembly.
